adaptations: React hook state becomes an owned mutex-protected controller shared by Ratatui row planning and painting.
Hunk registration object identity becomes a monotonic native registration identity assigned when an accepted subprocess registration is materialized.
Accepted layouts receive a monotonic per-ReviewApp generation; cache hits preserve it while refresh, width, content, view, reload, and registry changes prepare a successor generation.
The optional extension notification hub is the native equivalent of extensions.context.notify(message, warning); absent extension context intentionally remains a no-op.
Declarative v1 row trees are validated and painted by the host, but all component-paint failures still pass through the exact generation-aware warning boundary.
